description: Before and after, done right. Compare two periods as a slope or a dumbbell chart, straight from your model: one measure per period, or one measure plus a Year, Quarter, Month or Scenario column. No DAX tricks to connect the lines, no helper measures for labels or colours. With premium, the same chart becomes a business review pack: every period up to the latest 36, the Top N movers, one panel per region and a headline written from your data. Labels that never overlap. End labels spread apart with leader lines, and on a small canvas the least important ones give way first - they are never drawn on top of each other. Change annotations sit next to every line: % change, absolute change, both, percentage points (automatic for percent measures) or rank move. When a period starts at or below zero, the chart shows the absolute change instead of a misleading percentage. Free features (no license needed, no time limit): Slope and dumbbell views for any two periods, from two measures or a Period column; sort by last or first value, change, % change, name or data order Rising / falling / flat colouring with a dead band (e.g. +-2%), and a Higher is better switch for costs, defects or scrap Conditional formatting: category colours accept Power BI fx rules (rules, gradient or field value), and one rule colours every line Data labels: name, value, rank or both on each side, collision-free…
